product_name: Casio Edifice ECB-900DB-1BDR Bluetooth Analog-Digital Black Dial Men Watch Silver Metal Strap (EX500)

reviews.author: SubhamSubham
Sumit
reviews.text:
This is a masterpiece. The more I write about the watch, the lesser it is. There is no word to define this watch. Solar charge works perfectly. It comes with 50% factory charge. I kept it under sunlight for 2 hours on 2nd day and it is 65% charged. Light is very bright. Bluetooth works seamlessly. It looks very durable and hard because I will not test and dare to drop it to see how durable it is.Again I can keep going on writing about the watch and it will go endless. Last but not the least, I don't think any other watch can compete with the price tag.

reviews.author: Abhinav Panicker
reviews.text:
One of the best watches that one can buy if hus/her budget allows for the same. I fell in love with it the moment I saw it and without hesitation I ordered it. Haven't regretted it till date. The sheer quality and technology in-built makes you feel like it's worth more than what you've paid for. Love the fact that it's bluetooth enabled and solar powered as well.Like everyone in the review section has said it's a masterpiece of a watch.❤️

reviews.author: shashi shekharshashi shekhar
reviews.text:
The product is 100% genuine. Packaging was awesome. I registered the product online with the given serial number and got extended warranty; hence got total two and a half year warranty. Just connect the watch with the Edifice Bluetooth app on your phone and your watch will be automatically set according to your timezone. The total 6 alarms are amazing. Day and date with month display is amazing with LED light. I easily altered the strap according to my wrist size.
